name: camera-real
job: Produce or evaluate camera-captured realism while separating world-state causes from optics, sensor, computational photography, compression, and operator behavior.

slots.emits: Persistent character, relationship, location, and continuity constraints when a recurring world is involved.
World-to-capture causal graph, counterfactual capture checks, bounded defects, and authority-none receipt.

forbid: random camera defects unrelated to capture conditions
identity mutation from a realism evaluator
promote: Promote only after camera-specific procedural knowledge has at least two independent consumers and cannot remain a recipe profile.
